seed.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
seed.description:
• Checks port availability at the user's residential address
• Presents compatible internet speed packages for user selection
• Allocates a port and creates the subscription order
• Notifies the user and completes port configuration and physical connection
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    CreateOrder(selectedProduct, User.Address)
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE
